summary.title: Tamarside Rail Remote Maintenance
summary.description:
Classroom exercise modelling remote maintenance of Tamarside Rail level crossings.

Engineers connect through a VPN remote access gateway to a maintenance server using RDP. The server communicates with crossing controllers through rural 4G routers. Suppliers also access the gateway using a shared account. The maintenance server stores configuration and firmware files.

The model will identify threats to access, configuration changes and availability. Constraints include unreliable 4G coverage and safety-certified controllers whose firmware changes require re-approval.

diagrams.title: Tamarside Remote Maintenance
diagrams.description: Data flows and trust boundaries for engineer and supplier access to level crossing maintenance systems.
